terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Terms governing the use of the Ihyaa Program platform and participation in its events
terms.secAcceptanceBody: By accessing or using the Ihyaa Program platform, registering for any of our events, or creating a user account, you acknowledge and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service and our Privacy Policy.
terms.secEligibilityBody: Our services and events are designed for youth in Morocco. By registering, you confirm that you are at least 10 years of age and that all information provided is accurate and truthful.
terms.secAccountsBody: Users are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of their account credentials and password, and for all activities conducted under their account. Notify Ihyaa management immediately of any unauthorized access.
terms.secAcceptableUseBody: You agree to use the platform only for lawful purposes that foster positive values and community fellowship, and refrain from abusive behavior, inappropriate content, or attempts to compromise platform security.
terms.secRegistrationBody: Limited-capacity events are subject to approval and waitlist rules. Ihyaa Program organizers reserve the right to approve, reject, or cancel registrations based on organizational and capacity requirements.
terms.secUserContentBody: Users are solely responsible for photographs and data uploaded to their profile. Images must be respectful, appropriate for the public domain, and aligned with program values.
terms.secIpBody: All designs, logos, trademarks, and educational content on this platform are the exclusive property of Ihyaa Program and protected under applicable intellectual property laws.
terms.secDisclaimersBody: We strive to deliver the best experience possible; the platform is provided on an 'as is' basis without warranties against occasional technical interruptions outside our reasonable control.
terms.secSuspensionBody: Ihyaa Program reserves the right to suspend or terminate access for any user who violates these terms, misuses the platform, or disrupts event operations.
terms.secChangesBody: Program leadership may update these terms as needed. Continued use of the platform after updates constitutes acceptance of the modified terms.
terms.secLawBody: These terms are governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the Kingdom of Morocco, and Moroccan courts have jurisdiction over any disputes arising hereunder.
terms.secContactBody: For any inquiries regarding these terms, please contact us via phone or our official social media channels:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Protection
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your data and respect your privacy across Ihyaa Program services and events
privacy.secCollectionBody: We collect information necessary to deliver our services, including: full name, email address, encrypted password hash (bcrypt), city, age, profile photograph, event booking details, and contact messages. Additionally, you may optionally provide supplemental profile details (short bio, field of study, school/institution, interests, skills, languages spoken, and volunteer preferences) to help organizers tailor community activities. These optional details are entirely voluntary and visible only to you and verified platform administrators. Automated security metadata such as last login and last active timestamps are also recorded to safeguard account integrity.
privacy.secPurposeBody: We use your data to manage your account, confirm event attendance, send OTP verification codes, notify you of booking approvals or waitlist promotions, and respond to your inquiries.
privacy.secProcessorsBody: We partner with trusted technical providers to ensure reliable and secure services: Neon (database storage), Cloudinary (image hosting), Brevo (verification and transactional email), Google (quick sign-in), and Vercel (platform hosting).
privacy.secCookiesBody: We use only essential, encrypted session cookies required for authentication and account security. We do not use third-party advertising or commercial tracking cookies.
privacy.secRetentionBody: We retain your personal data for as long as your account remains active or as required for maintaining organized event attendance records.
privacy.secSecurityBody: We apply strict security measures including bcrypt password hashing, encrypted HTTPS across all connections, protected JWT sessions, and rate-limiting against automated abuse. Administrative operations follow a strict Role-Based Access Control model (USER, MODERATOR, ADMIN) with least privilege principles. Furthermore, critical administrative actions (such as role modifications, event updates, and account anonymizations) are permanently captured in an immutable audit log trail to ensure transparency and accountability.
privacy.secRightsBody: You have the right at any time to access your personal data, update it directly via your account page, or request deletion of your account and records by contacting us.
privacy.secChildrenBody: We care deeply about youth and strive to maintain a safe, constructive digital and physical environment conforming to educational and moral values.
privacy.secChangesBody: We may update this Privacy Policy to reflect service or technological advancements. We encourage reviewing this page periodically.
privacy.secContactBody: For any questions or requests regarding your personal privacy, reach out via phone or our official channels:
